results.q: A user experienced technical difficulties while using the Circles App, what should I do?
results.a:
Help users to solve the technical problems they experienced when using the Circles App by:




• Sending related infographics or other relevant media for users to read. You can take screenshots of any educational media, including the Circles Application Technical Guide.




• If appropriate, share the question in the user's WA group. This allows other participants to provide answer and participate in the problem solving process.




• If possible, guide the user to solve the problem directly by opening the app together.




Document the problems faced by users in a single doc and share with the Circles Bali team.

results.q: What should I do if a user prefer payment using cash/bank transfer rather than accepting Circles Points?
results.a:
1. Remind the participants of their commitment when joining the research program.




2. Re-explain the benefit of using Circles Points for their business, such as:

Accepting Circles Points or combination of Circles Points and cash for their goods/services

Accepting Circles Points for their surplus goods that would otherwise be wasted

Using Circles Points to restock their supply of raw materials with other Circles users that offers the materials needed

Using Circles Points as bonus / gift for their customer as a form of loyalty incentive or alike




3. Conduct an assessment within the following week to see if the user is willing to accept Circles for their business.




4. If the problem still persist, find another user who is more willing to fulfil the commitment in accepting Circles Points for the goods / services they offer.

results.q: Users do not feel the benefit of Circles for their business, what should I do?
results.a:
1. Ask questions that will identify why the user feels that they are not receiving benefits for their business by using Circles.




2. Remind users that inviting other businesses that offer the goods / services they need to restock their supply can be beneficial for themselves & their community.




3. Re-explain how Circles business model works by showing examples of how they can use Circles Points for their business:

Accepting Circles Points or combination of Circles Points and cash for their goods/services

Accepting Circles Points for their surplus goods that would otherwise be wasted

Using Circles Points to restock their supply of raw materials with other Circles users that offers the materials needed

Using Circles Points as bonus/gift for their customer as a form of loyalty incentive or alike




4. Conduct an assessment within the following week to see if the problem is solved.




5. If the problem still persist, find another user who is more willing to use the Circles app.

results.q: Users don't understand how to use the app, what should I do?
results.a:
Help user to understand how they can use the Circles app effectively by: 




Identifying the functions of the app that the users has not yet understand.  

Sharing related infographics or other relevant media for users to study. If needed, you can take screenshots of any educational media. 

Give an example on how to use the app by conducting direct transaction together with the user  




Document the problems faced by users and the solution provided in a single doc and share with the Circles Bali team.
